finding: 35 miRNA entries modulated across 2, 4 and 9 dpe, with sequences, logFC and p in Table 1.
exact_quote: The number of significantly modulated miRNAs increased from 5 or fewer at 2 and 4 dpe to 23 unique miRNAs by 9 dpe.
coverage_gap: Reads mapped to miRBase 17 and named per release 19, so several arm labels disagree with the sequence.

finding: 16 miRNAs with >2-fold change between DENV-2 blood meal (D) and regular blood meal (B) midguts; 13 up, 3 down.
exact_quote: Table 5 Significantly modulated miRNAs that displayed a < -2- or > 2-fold difference in expression between the midguts of mosquitoes that had ingested a DENV-2-infected blood meal (D) and those that had ingested a regular blood meal (B)
coverage_gap: Sequences come from the paper's Additional file 1 (Drive copy); miR-6134 is not in that file.

finding: 17 significant DE miRNAs between infected and uninfected midguts after the same DENV-2 meal; 15 up, 2 down.
exact_quote: Of these miRNAs, 15 were upregulated (miR-1420b-5p, miR-1767, miR-193-5p, miR-1951, miR-19c, miR-276-3p, miR-2941, miR-3811e-5p, miR-4110-5p, miR-424-3p, miR-5706, miR-6134, miR-622, miR-976-5p and miR-989) and two were downregulated (miR-1273f and miR-4448).
coverage_gap: No sequences in the paper; values and day (5/7/10 d) per miRNA are in Fig. 1b / Additional file 5, not available. Sequences used are guesses from Su et al. 2017 Additional file 1.

finding: 66 known DE miRNAs (15 up, 51 down) plus 4 novel; 12 named in the text with >50-fold change and 7 validated by RT-qPCR.
exact_quote: Based on p-value and log fold change, 66 known miRNAs (15 for up-regulated and 51 for down-regulated) and 4 novel candidate miRNAs (3 for up-regulated and 1 for down-regulated) were differentially expressed
coverage_gap: Full list of 66 with values and sequences is in a supplement not in Zotero (unavailable).

finding: Only 3 DE miRNAs in midgut at 1 dpi: miR-989 down, miR-2943 up, miR-2941 down.
exact_quote: a total of 85 known miRNAs were identified, with three known miRNAs differentially expressed (Table S5)
coverage_gap: Table S5 (values, sequences) unavailable.

finding: 12 miRNAs measured by RT-qPCR. C6/36 24 hpi: only miR-1891 down, the rest up. Adult females 7 dpi: different pattern.
exact_quote: After infection, only miR-1891 was down-regulated and the remaining miRNAs were up-regulated (Fig. 1).
quote_locator: Results, p.4; Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 (significance read from asterisks)
coverage_gap: Sequences/primers are in a supplementary TIFF on Drive, not transcribed. Text says miR-1889 and let-7 rise in females but Fig. 2 shows no asterisk for them.

finding: miR-281 up-regulated in midgut after DENV-2.
exact_quote: miR-281 has been found to be specifically expressed at a high level in the midgut of female adult mosquitoes and is up-regulated after DENV-2 infection.
coverage_gap: Arm not stated in the main text.

finding: 11 miRNAs DE in persistently infected C6-L cells vs both controls, plus 4 only vs acute infection; Tables 1-2 give sequences.
exact_quote: some miRNAs were up-regulated in C6-L cells compared with both control conditions (miR-927, miR-87, miR-2a-3p, miR-190, and miR-970) or down-regulated (miR-263a-3p, miR-92b, miR-9a-1, miR-9a-5p, miR-286a, and miR-286b), but others were altered only compared with acutely infected C6/36-HT cells.
quote_locator: Section 3.2, p.5 (approx.); Table 1 p.141; Table 2 p.142
coverage_gap: Table 1 gives miR-252 and miR-263a-3p the same sequence. miR-210 vs mock has p = 0.1665.

finding: miR-927 down in acute infection at 24-48 h, then up; up in persistent infection.
exact_quote: in acutely infected C6/36 cells, miR-927 was downregulated, but its expression was gradually and directly increased as a function of the duration of infection and the m.o.i. used
coverage_gap: Arm not stated in the main text.

finding: No miRNA change survives multiple-testing correction in DENV2-infected Aag2 cells.
exact_quote: After p-value correction for multiple testing, no change in miRNA expression is statistically significant.
coverage_gap: Table S1 still has one Miesen 2016 row (miR-11900, down).

finding: Reports isomiR class shifts and arm switching under DENV, not differential expression of mature miRNAs.
exact_quote: The 3′ multiple nucleotide extension (3MNE) class of isomiRs displayed statistically significant induction in response to DENV infection in miR-285-3p, miR-989-3p and miR-10-5p
coverage_gap: Table S1 has two Etebari 2015 rows (miR-276-3p, miR-10-5p) based on isomiR ratios.

finding: 143 DE miRNAs in C6/36 cells, but after DENV-1, not DENV-2.
exact_quote: our newly annotated Ae. albopictus miRNAs in C6/36 cells were differentially expressed after 3 days post-infection with DENV1. A total of 143 miRNAs were found to be differentially expressed (p-value < 0.05)
coverage_gap: Wrong serotype; DE list in Supplemental Table S2 (unavailable).

finding: Small RNA profiles mapped to transcript targets; no list of DE miRNAs.
exact_quote: sRNA profiles are altered early in DENV2 infection, and mRNA targets from mitochondrial, transcription/translation, and transport functional categories are affected.
coverage_gap: No named DE miRNAs to extract.

finding: miRNA discovery in Ae. albopictus and Culex; no infection experiment.
exact_quote: we provide evidence for over 60 conserved and seven novel mosquito miRNAs
coverage_gap: No DENV infection.

finding: Human miRNA screen against flaviviruses.
exact_quote: miR-34a transfection potently inhibited infection by all three flaviviruses compared to control miRNA (miR-Ct) transfection
coverage_gap: Host is human, not mosquito.

finding: 17 Ae. aegypti miRNAs differentially modulated across 2, 7 and 14 dpi with ZIKV (23 study x miRNA x time rows), most of them depleted.
exact_quote: only 17 miRNAs were identified as differentially modulated at all the time points, with the majority of them significantly depleted in response to ZIKV infection (Table 1)
coverage_gap: No sequences in the paper; Table 1 prints the p column as '> 0.001', read here as < 0.001.

finding: 41 miRNAs significantly DE in Ae. albopictus Singh's cells 24 h after CHIKV; 4 named as over-expressed, 4 as under-expressed, plus 7 novel miRNAs.
exact_quote: revealed 41 miRNAs to be significant differentially expressed in Aedes (p value < 0.05). It is noteworthy that most of the miRNAs were down-regulated upon CHIKV infection.
quote_locator: Results, p.4; sequences and TPM in Tables 2-4, pp.5-7
coverage_gap: Only the 8 named miRNAs plus the 7 significant novel ones are extracted; the full list of 41 is in Fig 1 only. logFC computed here from the TPM columns.

finding: Read counts for every miRNA in uninfected and CHIKV-infected Ae. aegypti and Ae. albopictus saliva (Tables 1-4), including novel miRNAs with sequences.
exact_quote: The highly expressed miRNAs, aae-mir-bantam, aae-mir-263a, aae-mir-125 and aae-mir-285 were upregulated in CHIKV-infected Ae.aegypti saliva with counts of 18002 (2.0-fold), 20584 (2.6-fold), 15735 (3.0-fold) and 10006 (>100-fold)
coverage_gap: The 'Fold Difference' column of Tables 1-4 is library-size normalised in Table 1 and inconsistent in Tables 2 and 4, so fold changes here are log2(infected/uninfected) of the printed read counts. No replicates and no statistical test, so no p value.

finding: Most differentially expressed miRNAs between Aag2 and Wolbachia wMelPop-CLA (Pop) cells, given separately for the nucleus and the cytoplasm with log2 fold changes.
exact_quote: In the nucleus, miR-989 and miR-306-5p were down-regulated and miR-2765 and Bantam-5p were up-regulated.
coverage_gap: Table 2 gives fold changes but no p values; the minus signs of negative fold changes come out as '2' in the extracted text and were read from the sign of the log2 column.

finding: 44 miRNAs DE between wAlbB-infected (WB2) and tetracycline-cleared (WB2.tet) females, split across 2, 6 and 12 dpe (46 rows in Table 1).
exact_quote: For comparison between Wolbachia-infected and uninfected mosquitoes, miRNAs with an adjusted p value of < 0.05 and an absolute log2 fold-change of > 0.5 were considered differentially expressed. A total of 44 miRNAs met these criteria (Table 1).
coverage_gap: No sequences in the paper; names follow the AaegL5.0 annotation of this study, so some arm labels are newer than Table S1's. The p column holds the FDR.

finding: 55 DE miRNAs between Wolbachia wAlbB-infected (W+) and uninfected (W-) Aag2 cells; 11 of the top 15 up or down were confirmed by qPCR in whole-cell and cytoplasm samples.
exact_quote: we identified a total of 55 DE miRNAs out of 164 mature miRNAs with annotations in miRBase, including 26 upregulated miRNAs and 26 downregulated miRNAs in W+ cells
coverage_gap: Only the 11 qPCR-confirmed miRNAs are extracted; the full list of 55 is in S2 Table (unavailable). No sequences and no fold changes in the main text. This study is Wolbachia, not DENV-2: it was set aside while this table covered DENV-2 only.

finding: 13 miRNAs significantly regulated in Ae. aegypti Aag2 cells at 12 and 24 h after CHIKV infection.
exact_quote: Three miRNAs (miR-2b, miR-2951-5p, and miR-10-5p) were found to be significantly regulated (p <= 0.05) in the 12 h.p.i. library ... eleven miRNAs were significantly regulated in the 24 h.p.i. library
coverage_gap: No sequences and no fold changes in the text; values are only in the Fig 1B heatmap. Supplementary Table 3 gives TPM but not DE statistics.

finding: Cellular miRNAs up- or down-regulated in wMelPop-CLA infected females at 4 and 12 days post-emergence, by microarray and Northern blot.
exact_quote: We observed induction of aae-miR-2940, aae-miR-309a-2, aae-miR-2943-1, and aae-miR-970 at 4 d and 12 d after emergence and of aae-miR-308* and aae-miR-2941-2 at 4 d after emergence in Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes.
coverage_gap: Microarray and densitometry only: no per-miRNA p value, fold change or sequence.

finding: Seven blood-meal-induced miRNAs compared between wMelPop-CLA infected (+Wol) and tetracycline-treated (-Wol) females by Northern blot.
exact_quote: Most of the miRNAs were also found in higher quantities in +Wol mosquitoes compared to -Wol mosquitoes (Fig. 1).
coverage_gap: The paper says 'most of the miRNAs' without saying which, so the per-miRNA direction is a reading of Fig 1, not a stated result. This study's main comparison is blood-fed vs non-blood-fed, not Wolbachia.

finding: aae-miR-2940 induction by Wolbachia is the premise; the study's own work is the target AaDnmt2.
exact_quote: altered the expression of a number of host miRNAs, including aae-miR-2940 in the host mosquito Ae. aegypti (18)
coverage_gap: The induction itself is cited from Hussain 2011, not measured here; no fold change or p value.

finding: aae-miR-2940 induction by Wolbachia is the premise; the study's own work is the target AaArgM3.
exact_quote: we identified and confirmed that aae-miR-2940, which is induced in the presence of Wolbachia, enhances the expression of a protein arginine methyltransferase, AaArgM3
coverage_gap: The induction itself is carried over from Hussain 2011; no fold change or p value. Not in Table S1 at all.

finding: aae-miR-12 up-regulated in Wolbachia-infected cells; the study's own work is on the targets MCT1 and MCM6.
exact_quote: the difference was concurrent with the up-regulation of aae-miR-12 in Wolbachia-infected (+Wol) mosquitoes based on further analysis of the microarray data [11]
coverage_gap: The up-regulation comes from re-analysis of the Hussain 2011 microarray; no fold change or p value here.

finding: aae-miR-2940-5p induced by Wolbachia in every tissue tested, most strongly in midgut and fat body.
exact_quote: Northern blot analysis of RNA isolated from various tissues (muscle was not included) of Pop and Tet Ae. aegypti mosquitoes confirmed induction of aae-miR-2940-5p due to Wolbachia infection in all tissues, with substantial induction in the midgut and fat body (Fig 6A).
coverage_gap: Northern blot only: no fold change or p value per tissue.

finding: Functional follow-up on miR-2944b-5p and miR-2b; the differential expression itself is taken from the group's earlier CHIKV study.
exact_quote: we identified two miRNAs, namely, miR-2944b-5p and miR-2b, that were most significantly regulated upon CHIKV infection in a previous study [23]
coverage_gap: No DE experiment of its own; the DE call belongs to Shrinet 2014 / Dubey 2017.

finding: No miRNA significantly changed in Ae. aegypti salivary glands after CHIKV, and only 5 in saliva with weak support.
exact_quote: we conclude that, at least in our experimental conditions, infection by the chikungunya virus does not significantly modulate miRNA expression profiles in Ae. aegypti saliva and salivary glands
coverage_gap: Directly contradicts the large saliva CHIKV list of Maharaj 2015, which had no replicates. Table S1 has no Fiorillo rows.
